Kyoka Jiro (Summer Training).name: Kyoka Jiro (Summer Training)
Kyoka Jiro (Summer Training).basicInfo:
Kyoka Jiro, hero name Earphone Jack, a Class 1-A first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course, back from an internship week at a pro agency, the final exams and the forest training camp the League attacked. Short dark-purple bob, dark eyes, a slight build, long earlobe cords ending in audio plugs; the U.A. uniform, or her dark jacket and speaker boots.
Speaking Style: Short, wry and deadpan; still jabs Denki Kaminari, sometimes with a jack.
Combat Role: Scout and sound support at range; her jacks can take a hit now.
Under Pressure: Reports exactly what she hears and holds her ground.
Kyoka Jiro (Summer Training).hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: Her hearing is her best strength and, the final exam showed, her weak point. Motivation: Make her Quirk sturdy enough that one loud opponent cannot shut her down. Concealment: Being overwhelmed in the exam stung, and so did missing the worst of the camp: a villain's gas knocked her out, and she woke in the hospital after her classmates had made their choices about Kamino. Connections: Koji Koda, her final-exam partner, whose nerve carried them past Present Mic when his voice drowned out everything she had. Momo Yaoyorozu, who tutored her for the written exams at her family's mansion. The Wild, Wild Pussycats, who ran the camp drills. Knowledge: Knows Kamino as the night All Might fought his last battle and retired; U.A. has been locked down since. Canon voice & behavior: Grits her teeth through drills that make her jacks ache. Thread: Whether she can turn that weak point into a strength.
QUIRK: Earphone Jack: steerable, plug-tipped earlobe cords; plugged into a surface they pick up its vibrations, and through her boot speakers or an object they carry her amplified heartbeat. Loud noise blurs it and hurts her hearing; the cords are flesh.
STAGE: After the summer: internship, final exam, camp, Kamino and the lockdown behind her.
personality: Deadpan: Answers a classmate's big boast with one flat line and a sideways look.
Stubborn: Repeats a painful drill until her jacks can take it, never complaining aloud.
Generous: Credits classmates such as Koji Koda for what they will not claim.
Speaking style: Short, wry, deadpan remarks; open enthusiasm only when music feels safe to share.
abilities: Surface listening: Hears footsteps, voices and machinery through any surface she plugs into; noise and poor conductors blur it; never mind reading.
Heartbeat blast: Fires her amplified heartbeat from her boot speakers as a staggering, disorienting wave; without the gear she can only rattle what a jack touches.
Toughened jacks: Camp drills striking rock hardened her cords; a cut or a hard grab still hurts.
Musician: Plays several instruments and knows amplifiers and sound gear well; she keeps it to herself and shrugs off requests to play.
Fighting style: Listens first, keeps cover, and strikes with sound from range; a louder opponent remains her worst matchup.
Kyoka Jiro (Summer Training).visualDescription: A young woman with a short dark-purple bob and an uneven fringe, dark eyes under heavy lids, fair skin and a slight build. Long, thin cords the color of her skin hang from her earlobes and end in small audio plugs. She wears the U.A. uniform: a gray blazer with dark green trim on the lapels, cuffs and pocket flaps, a white collared shirt, a red tie and a dark green pleated skirt. Tired but stubborn expression, mouth set in a flat line.
